nodes.description: Internal owner address stored in BotProtected, used as the privileged account in YAEToken.
Private address of the Ferrum bot-protection contract that is called with a low-level call.
Public address of the Uniswap pair, derived in the YAEToken constructor and passed to the bot protection call.
Constructor that initialises the botProtection address.
Modifier that performs a low-level external call to botProtection and requires it to succeed before the guarded body is executed.
Low-level botProtection.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0x15274141,...)) whose success is only checked with require(notABot); return data is ignored.
Public mapping of account balances, directly overwritten in transferFrom and list.
Public nested mapping of allowances, set to unlimited values in the constructor and mutated in transferFrom/approve.
Constant decimals value (18).
Public total supply, read in list to compute owner allocations.
Token name string (Cryptonovae).
Token symbol string (YAE).
Uniswap V2 router instance used for addLiquidityETH.
WETH address used with address(this) to derive the uniPair.
Constructor that sets owner to msg.sender, derives uniPair and grants unlimited allowances.
Payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Core token transfer logic guarded by the checkBots modifier; mutates balances and allowances with raw arithmetic.
Sets the allowance of _spender for msg.sender.
Owner-only function that executes an arbitrary delegatecall, giving full control over the contract.
Pure helper computing the deterministic Uniswap pair address from tokenA and tokenB.
Owner-only listing function that sets balances, adds liquidity to the router and rewrites holder balances in a loop.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary attacker/owner supplied bytecode in the token's storage context.
External payable call to uniRouter.addLiquidityETH with msg.value and a block.timestamp based deadline.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, approvals and transfer sources.
Block timestamp used to build the addLiquidityETH deadline (block.timestamp + 600).
Constructor parameter of BotProtected holding the bot protection contract address.
Source address parameter of the checkBots modifier.
Destination address parameter of the checkBots modifier.
Amount parameter of the checkBots modifier.
Boolean flag returned by the botProtection low-level call and used in require.
Unused bytes return data from the botProtection low-level call.
Constructor parameter of YAEToken forwarded to BotProtected.
Recipient parameter of YAEToken.transfer.
Amount parameter of YAEToken.transfer.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Target address parameter of delegate, used as the delegatecall destination.
Calldata bytes parameter of delegate, used as delegatecall payload.
First token parameter of pairFor.
Second token parameter of pairFor.
Liquidity amount parameter of list, also written to the contract balance.
Array of recipient addresses in list.
Array of amounts assigned to recipients in list.
Loop index controlling the balance overwrite loop in list.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _botProtection is consumed by the BotProtected constructor.
Constructor stores _botProtection into the botProtection state variable.
botProtection address is the target of the low-level call.
checkBots modifier executes the low-level botProtection call before the guarded body.
The external call to the untrusted botProtection contract can re-enter the function guarded by the modifier.
_from is encoded into the botProtection.call calldata.
_to is encoded into the botProtection.call calldata.
_value is encoded into the botProtection.call calldata.
notABot return value is checked by require inside the modifier.
isNotBot return data is decoded but never validated in the modifier.
uniPair state variable is passed as an argument to the botProtection call.
YAEToken constructor parameter is forwarded to the BotProtected constructor.
msg.sender becomes the privileged owner during YAEToken construction.
YAEToken constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable controlling privileged functions.
Constructor invokes pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
uniPair state variable is assigned from the pairFor result.
wETH state variable is read as the pair token in the constructor.
uniRouter is read in the constructor to receive an unlimited allowance.
Constructor writes unlimited allowances (uint(-1)) into the allowance mapping for the router and msg.sender.
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from to decide whether an allowance is required.
_from parameter drives the balanceOf reads/writes in transferFrom.
_to parameter drives the balanceOf writes in transferFrom.
_value parameter determines the transferred amount in transferFrom.
transferFrom applies the checkBots modifier at entry.
transferFrom mutates the balanceOf mapping using raw unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom decrements the allowance mapping of msg.sender.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source address.
_to parameter is forwarded to transferFrom by transfer.
_value parameter is forwarded to transferFrom by transfer.
approve writes the allowance of msg.sender.
_spender parameter keys the allowance mapping in approve.
_value parameter is stored as the allowance in approve.
approve mutates the allowance mapping for the caller.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner, an access-control gate protecting arbitrary delegatecall.
delegate executes the low-level delegatecall operation.
Parameter a is the target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b supplies the calldata executed by the delegatecall.
Arbitrary delegated code can re-enter the token contract with full storage control.
tokenA parameter is hashed into the pair address computation.
tokenB parameter is hashed into the pair address computation.
list requires msg.sender == owner before overwriting balances.
_numList parameter is assigned to the contract balance and liquidity amount.
_tos parameter supplies the recipients of the balance overwrite loop.
_amounts parameter supplies the balances assigned to each recipient.
list directly overwrites entries of the balanceOf mapping.
list reads totalSupply to compute the owner allocation.
block.timestamp is used to build the addLiquidityETH deadline, making liquidity listing miner-timestamp dependent.
list makes the external payable addLiquidityETH call to the router.
The external call into the router/pair can re-enter the token contract before state is finalised.
Loop index i controls the iteration rewriting holder balances.
uniRouter state variable is the call target of addLiquidityETH.
